# #4937: Patch: route six held-set hooks through the engine's read helpers instead of `GameState` fields
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Card scripts are supposed to read the board only through the engine's read helpers, never raw state fields. Six newer scripts read the raw state directly. The game plays the same either way, but the six contradict the documented contract and will mislead the next person who copies them. This swaps each read for its helper with no behavior change.

## Why

crates/cards/README.md (section 1) states a hook may read the state only through the engine's read helpers, never a `GameState` field: no script names `state.players[...]` above its `#[cfg(test)]`. Six hooks in the held set do exactly that, all above their test modules: c174_scrape_the_graveyard.rs:17, c175_fingerprinter.rs:19, c177_predictive_text.rs:21-22, c184_pattern_recognition.rs:97, c186_identity_theft.rs:17, c188_overfitting.rs:60. Every other repo-wide hit was checked per file and sits below `#[cfg(test)]` (test code, which the contract allows), e.g. c035_rollback.rs:157,871,1031, t_coin.rs:106,327, c045_knowledge_breaker.rs:144,244, c207_recursive_self_improvement.rs:112,117,118. Each has an existing helper spelling: `zone_cards` (Graveyard/Hand/Library), `zone_count` (Hand), and `fill_board_zones` (already used by meditative/c097_9, crates/engine/src/zones.rs).

## Proposal

Mechanical swaps: graveyard/hand/library reads to `zone_cards` with the matching `OffFieldZone`, the two hand `.len()` reads to `zone_count`, and the empty-zone scan to `fill_board_zones`. No logic changes.

## Where it lands

The six files under crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/. No spec change (behavior identical).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No `state.players` read above `#[cfg(test)]` in those six files
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards infinite_assault` green
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings` green

## Size and risks

S. Zero behavior risk: purely mechanical, covered by the cards' existing base/Radiant tests.
